title: trace_flow input
description: Input for `trace_flow`. `from` takes exactly one of endpoint / symbol / table. `direction` defaults to `upstream` for a table and `downstream` otherwise.

from.description: Exactly one of `endpoint`, `symbol`, `table` must be set.

symbol.description: A node id, or a symbol name (ambiguous names are rejected with candidates).

repo_id.description: Restrict a symbol name to one repository.

table.description: A table name, with or without the `table:` prefix.

strategy.description: `breadth` (default): everything one hop at a time, nearest first, each node reached once. `depth`: follow each chain to its end (leaf, data sink or depth limit) before backtracking, so chains that share a node are all reported.
